16.odr_com: And my bowe shal be in the cloudes, and I shal see it, and I shal remember the euerlasting couenant, that was made betwen God and euerie liuing soule of al flesh which is vpon the earth.
16.sabates_a: And my bow shall be in the clouds, and I shall see it, and I shall remember the everlasting covenant, that was made between God and every living soul of all flesh which is upon the earth.
16.madueke_b: And my bow shall be in the clouds, and I shall see it, and I shall remember the everlasting covenant, that was made between God and every living soul of all flesh which is upon the earth.

17.s_dismas: And God ſaid to Noe: This ſhal be the ſigne of the couenant, which I eſtablished, betwen me & al flesh of the earth.
17.odr_com: And God said to Noe: This shal be the signe of the couenant, which I established, betwen me & al flesh of the earth.
17.sabates_a: And God said to Noe: This shall be the sign of the covenant, which I established between me & all flesh of the earth.
17.madueke_b: And God said to Noe: This shall be the sign of the covenant, which I established between me & all flesh of the earth.

18.s_dismas: The ſonnes therfore of Noe, that came out of the arke, were Sem, Cham, and Iapheth: and Cham he is the father of Chanaan.
18.odr_com: The sonnes therfore of Noe, that came out of the arke, were Sem, Cham, and Iaphet: and Cham he is the father of Chanaan.
18.sabates_a: The sons therefore of Noe, that came out of the ark, were Sem, Cham, and Japheth: and Cham he is the father of Chanaan.
18.madueke_b: The sons therefore of Noe, that came out of the ark, were Sem, Cham, and Japheth: and Cham he is the father of Chanaan.

19.s_dismas: Theſe three are the ſonnes of Noe: and of theſe was al mankind ſpred ouer the whole earth.
19.odr_com: These three are the sonnes of Noe: and of these was al mankind spred ouer the whole earth.
19.sabates_a: These three are the sons of Noe: and of these was all mankind spread over the whole earth.
19.madueke_b: These three are the sons of Noe: and of these was all mankind spread over the whole earth.

20.s_dismas: And Noe a huſbandman began to til the grounde, and planted a vineyard.
20.odr_com: And Noe a husbandman began to til the grounde, and planted a vineyard.
20.sabates_a: And Noe a husbandman began to till the ground, and planted a vineyard.
20.madueke_b: And Noe a husbandman began to till the ground, and planted a vineyard.

21.s_dismas: And drinking of the wine was made drunke, and naked in his tabernacle.
21.odr_com: And drinking of the wine was made drunke, and naked in his tabernacle.
21.sabates_a: And drinking of the wine was made drunk, and naked in his tabernacle.
21.madueke_b: And drinking of the wine was made drunk, and naked in his tabernacle.

22.s_dismas: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan, had ſeene, to wit that his fathers priuities were bare, he told it to his two bretheren abroad.
22.odr_com: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan, had seene, to wit that his fathers priuities were bare, he told it to his two bretheren abroad.
22.sabates_a: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan had seen, to wit that his father's privities were bare, he told it to his two brethren abroad.
22.madueke_b: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan had seen, to wit that his father's privities were bare, he told it to his two brethren abroad.

23.s_dismas: But in dede Sem and Iapheth put a cloake vpon their ſhoulders, and going backward, couered the priuities of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they ſawe not their fathers priuities.
23.odr_com: But in dede Sem and Iapheth put a cloake vpon their shoulders, and going backward, couered the priuities of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they sawe not their fathers priuities.
23.sabates_a: But indeed Sem and Japhet put a cloak upon their shoulders, and going backward, covered the privities of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they saw not their father's privities.
23.madueke_b: But indeed Sem and Japhet put a cloak upon their shoulders, and going backward, covered the privities of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they saw not their father's privities.

24.s_dismas: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger ſonne had done to him,
24.odr_com: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger sonne had done to him,
24.sabates_a: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger son had done to him,
24.madueke_b: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger son had done to him,

25.s_dismas: he ſaid: Curſed be Chanaan, a ſeruant of ſeruantes ſhal he be vnto his bretheren.
25.odr_com: he said: Cursed be Chanaan, a seruant of seruantes shal he be vnto his bretheren.
25.sabates_a: he said: Cursed be Chanaan, a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
25.madueke_b: he said: Cursed be Chanaan, a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

26.s_dismas: And he ſaid: Bleſſed be the Lord God of Sem, Chanaan be his ſeruant.
26.odr_com: And he said: Blessed be the Lord God of Sem, Chanaan be his seruant.
26.sabates_a: And he saith: Blessed be the Lord God of Sem, Chanaan be his servant.
26.madueke_b: And he saith: Blessed be the Lord God of Sem, Chanaan be his servant.

27.s_dismas: God enlarge Iapheth, and dwel he in the tabernacles of Sem, and Chanaan be his ſeruant.
27.odr_com: God enlarge Iapheth, and dwel he in the tabernacles of Sem, and Chanaan be his seruant.
27.sabates_a: God enlarge Japheth, and dwell he in the tabernacles of Sem, and Chanaan be his servant.
27.madueke_b: God enlarge Japheth, and dwell he in the tabernacles of Sem, and Chanaan be his servant.

28.s_dismas: And Noe liued after the floud three hundred fiftie yeares.
28.odr_com: And Noe liued after the floud three hundred fiftie yeares.
28.sabates_a: And Noe lived after the flood three hundred fifty years.
28.madueke_b: And Noe lived after the flood three hundred fifty years.

29.s_dismas: And al his dayes were in the whole nyne hundred fiftie yeares: and he died.
29.odr_com: And al his dayes were in the whole nyne hundred fiftie yeares: and he died.
29.sabates_a: And all his days were in the whole nine hundred fifty years: and he died.
29.madueke_b: And all his days were in the whole nine hundred fifty years: and he died.

janvier_by_verse.1: And God blessed Noe and his sons, And he said to them: Increase & multiply, and replenish the earth.
janvier_by_verse.2: And your terror and dread be it upon all the beasts of the earth, and upon all the fowls of the air, with all that move upon the earth: all the fishes of the sea are delivered to your hand.
janvier_by_verse.3: And all that moveth and liveth shall be yours for meat: even as the green herbs have I delivered all to you.
janvier_by_verse.4: Saving that flesh with blood you shall not eat.
janvier_by_verse.5: For I will require the blood of your souls at the hands of all beasts: and at the hand of man, at the hand of each man, and of his brother, will I require the soul of man.
janvier_by_verse.6: Whosoever shall shed man's blood, his blood shall be shed: for to the image of God man was made.
janvier_by_verse.7: But increase you and multiply, and go upon the earth, and fill it.
janvier_by_verse.8: Thus also said God to Noe, and his sons with him:
janvier_by_verse.9: Behold I will establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you:
janvier_by_verse.10: and with every living soul that is with you, as well in all fowls as in cattle & beasts of the earth that are come forth out of the ark, and in all beasts of the earth.
janvier_by_verse.11: I will establish my covenant with you, and all flesh shall be no more destroyed with the waters of a flood, neither shall there be from hence-forth a flood to waste the earth.
janvier_by_verse.12: And God said: This is the sign of the covenant which I give between me and you, and between every living soul, that is with you, for perpetual generations:
janvier_by_verse.13: my bow will I set in the clouds, and it shall be the sign of a covenant between me and between the earth.
janvier_by_verse.14: And when I shall cover the element with clouds, my bow shall appear in the clouds:
janvier_by_verse.15: and I shall remember my covenant with you, and with every living soul that beareth flesh: and there shall no more be waters of a flood, to destroy all flesh.
janvier_by_verse.16: And my bow shall be in the clouds, and I shall see it, and I shall remember the everlasting covenant, that was made between God and every living soul of all flesh which is upon the earth.
janvier_by_verse.17: And God said to Noe: This shall be the sign of the covenant, which I established between me & all flesh of the earth.
janvier_by_verse.18: The sons therefore of Noe, that came out of the ark, were Sem, Cham, and Japheth: and Cham he is the father of Chanaan.
janvier_by_verse.19: These three are the sons of Noe: and of these was all mankind spread over the whole earth.
janvier_by_verse.20: And Noe a husbandman began to till the ground, and planted a vineyard.
janvier_by_verse.21: And drinking of the wine was made drunk, and naked in his tabernacle.
janvier_by_verse.22: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan had seen, to wit that his father's privities were bare, he told it to his two brethren abroad.
janvier_by_verse.23: But indeed Sem and Japhet put a cloak upon their shoulders, and going backward, covered the privities of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they saw not their father's privities.
janvier_by_verse.24: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger son had done to him,
janvier_by_verse.25: he said: Cursed be Chanaan, a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
janvier_by_verse.26: And he saith: Blessed be the Lord God of Sem, Chanaan be his servant.
janvier_by_verse.27: God enlarge Japheth, and dwell he in the tabernacles of Sem, and Chanaan be his servant.
janvier_by_verse.28: And Noe lived after the flood three hundred fifty years.
janvier_by_verse.29: And all his days were in the whole nine hundred fifty years: and he died.
